{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Thermal base layer: fitted long-sleeve top, hip length, warm ivory (#F1E9DA), fine merino wool
Refined knit: slim crewneck sweater, hip length, deep teal (#1F5B5E), merino-cashmere blend
Trousers: straight-leg, full length to the top of the boot, charcoal (#3A3D42), wool-blend flannel with a soft texture
Outer layer: single-breasted coat, knee length, with a storm collar and a lining, espresso brown (#3E2A20), dense wool with a water-repellent finish
Shoes: ankle boots with a lug rubber sole, a low block heel and a waterproof seal, dark chocolate (#2B1D16), waxed full-grain leather that resists road salt
Socks: mid-calf, charcoal melange (#4A4D52), merino wool
Scarf: large and soft, wrapped twice, burgundy (#6E2234), lambswool
Hat: close-fitting beanie that covers the ears, charcoal (#3A3D42), ribbed wool with a fleece lining
Gloves: lined, black (#1A1A1A), leather with a cashmere lining
Bag: structured tote that closes with a zip, dark chocolate (#2B1D16), grained leather that wipes clean of salt

Why this outfit works: The thin merino base layer, the knit and the dense wool coat trap warmth for a 20-minute walk in deep frost and snow, while the knit and flannel trousers still look neat enough for the office. Waxed boots with a gripping sole keep your feet dry and steady on snowy pavement and protect the leather from salt. Teal and burgundy near your face suit your warm skin, dark hair and brown eyes, and the espresso, charcoal and chocolate base keeps everything calm and professional. Once you take off the coat, hat and scarf, you are ready for work without changing."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2417,"output_tokens":1004},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
